metaDescription: London Concrete Forming won London's 2026 Foundation Repair & Waterproofing award. See its forming, driveway and retaining wall work before you call.
summary: London Concrete Forming is a residential concrete contractor in London, Ontario, handling foundation forming, driveways, patios, retaining walls and shed pads. The company has completed more than 500 projects across Southwestern Ontario over 20-plus years of combined team experience.

editorial.heading: What They Do
editorial.text: London Concrete Forming's core work is concrete forming, the process of building and pouring the structural formwork used for foundations, alongside general residential flatwork such as driveways, patios, retaining walls, stamped concrete and shed pads. That combination of structural forming and decorative flatwork is what carried the company to a win in the Foundation Repair & Waterproofing category. Its listed services span both categories rather than one narrow specialty.

editorial.heading: How They Work
editorial.text: The company describes premium concrete mixes and detailed site preparation as central to its process, with an explicit focus on Ontario-winter durability rather than a bare minimum pour. Rates are presented as transparent, meaning homeowners are expected to receive a clear quote rather than a vague estimate range. With more than 500 completed projects, the team has repeat exposure to the freeze-thaw conditions common across the region.

editorial.heading: What to Expect
editorial.text: No customer reviews were available for this listing at the time of research, so homeowners should ask directly for recent local references and, where possible, view completed forming or flatwork in person. This is a normal request for any concrete contractor and a legitimate one to make regardless of review count.

editorial.heading: Where They Work
editorial.text: London Concrete Forming is based in London and lists work across London, St. Thomas, Woodstock, Stratford, Sarnia and Chatham. Homeowners outside that footprint should confirm coverage before requesting a quote.

questionsToAsk: Can you share photos or addresses of recent forming or foundation work in my area?
What concrete mix strength and reinforcement do you use for foundation versus flatwork pours?
How do you handle drainage and grading around a new foundation or retaining wall?
What is included in the written quote, and what would trigger an extra charge?

faq.q: What does the Service Excellence Award mean?
faq.a: It means London Concrete Forming was selected as the top business in the Foundation Repair & Waterproofing category for London through an independent editorial review of public information and service scope. No business pays a fee to be selected.

faq.q: Why does a concrete forming company win a foundation award?
faq.a: Concrete forming is the process of building the formwork that shapes and holds a foundation pour, so it sits within foundation-related work even though the company also pours driveways, patios and other flatwork.

faq.q: Do they do more than foundations?
faq.a: Yes. Listed services include concrete driveway installation, patios, retaining walls, stamped concrete and shed pads alongside forming, so the company covers most residential flatwork needs.
The company lists work across London, St. Thomas, Woodstock, Stratford, Sarnia and Chatham, according to its own service description.
